policy: Every package.json override must be exact, owned, justified, review-triggered and removable when the upstream dependency graph is safe.

overrides.reason: Pins the verified safe version for the Production dependency advisory closed through PR #93.
overrides.reviewTrigger: Review on every @sentry/nextjs or lockfile dependency update and before the final Release Candidate.
overrides.expiryPolicy: Remove only after npm ls and the Production audit prove every reachable path resolves to a safe upstream version without the override.
